description: This file defines the interface for a DoorBell class and its nested Connector class, which manage doorbell signaling and resource handling in a networked environment. It includes method declarations for ringing, acknowledging, waiting, and unbinding doorbell connections, as well as internal mechanisms for socket communication and event signaling.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a doorbell mechanism for signaling between networked components, providing methods to ring, acknowledge, wait, and manage connections.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles network resource binding, unbinding, and signaling for the DoorBell, including socket communication and event handling.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ring
methods.description: Triggers the doorbell signal and sets the event.

methods.name: DoorBell::Wait
methods.description: Waits for the doorbell event to be signaled within a specified timeout.

methods.name: DoorBell::Ringing
methods.description: Internal method to set the event when a ring is received.
